Mod.Name: 【玩法】掌柜帮手·高级科学家 | [Gameplay] Shopkeeper's Kit: Advanced Scientist
Mod.Author: ChaosN
Mod.Description:
【玩法型：新职业，改变游戏机制】新增职业“高级科学家”（职业选择界面第 2 页），精通模组工艺。开局：机器区、空白模组制造机、词条镶嵌机（各附电池）、三块随机模组。空白模组制造机：每晚把电子元件、金属、线缆做成低 / 中 / 高级空白模组（1 / 2 / 3 个词条槽）。词条提取机（找杰克逊博士买，只卖给高级科学家）：把模组的数值做成基础芯片、特殊词条做成特殊词条芯片，模组变回空白模组。词条镶嵌机：把芯片镶到空白模组上，数值相加，特殊词条按游戏规则最多 2 个。机器都是每晚耗电做一次。职业能力：直接放在机器区里的机器每天按两天运转（设置里可关）。词条合成机后续加入。界面中英双语，跟随游戏语言。 掌柜帮手系列 · 作者 ChaosN · 由 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编程助手）协助开发。
[Gameplay - new profession, changes game mechanics] Adds the "Advanced Scientist" profession (page 2 of the profession screen), a module-crafting expert. Starts with a Machine Bay, the Blank Module Maker and the Affix Inlayer (each with a battery) and three random modules. Blank Module Maker: each night turns electronic parts, metal and wire into low / mid / high grade blank modules (1 / 2 / 3 slots). Affix Extractor (sold by Dr. Jackson, to Advanced Scientists only): turns a module's stats into a base chip and its special affixes into affix chips; the module becomes a blank. Affix Inlayer: puts chips into blank modules; stats add up, special affixes follow the game's rules (at most 2). All machines use power and run once per night. Ability: machines placed directly in a Machine Bay run two days' worth every day (can be turned off). A chip merger comes later. UI in Chinese and English, following the game language. Part of Shopkeeper's Kit by ChaosN. Developed with assistance from Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant).
